request: Harden the existing JANUS public-source gateway and test GDELT availability at a real user-controlled network endpoint; do not modify NAS containers without a separately approved exact deployment target.

security_controls: mandatory Nginx BasicAuth hashed user file
per-IP request limit 12 per minute burst 3
upstream gateway port 8000 exposed only to internal Docker network
read-only root filesystem, cap_drop ALL, no new privileges
public search off by default JANUS_PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_ENABLED=0

gdelt_api_cooldown.disclaimer: This process-local pacing does not coordinate multiple replicas or override provider/network rate limits.

required_followup: Identify user-approved trusted deployment host and ingress domain/certificate and obtain explicit permission before touching NAS
Configure protected user credentials and TLS secrets solely on host, never in GitHub PR
Test unauthorized request=401 and authorized MCP read-only call on the deployed host
Do not bypass DOC HTTP429; prefer sanctioned GDELT bulk manifests/raw data with bounded ingestion if needed
Verify quotas and alerts, produce signed deployment receipt and rollback plan
